name: Supplementary Report to the Security Policy Report 2021 (2022)
owner: Federal Office for Cyber Security (FOCS / BACS) / National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC)
description: Supplementary Report to the Security Policy Report 2021 on the consequences of the war in Ukraine (September 7, 2022, BBl 2022 2357). Overarching national security strategy report of the Swiss Federal Council prepared by the State Secretariat for Security Policy (SEPOS / DDPS), defining Switzerland's security policy environment, hybrid and cyber defense posture, and strategic priorities.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Federal Office for Cyber Security (FOCS / BACS) / National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) (ncsc.ch) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Federal Office for Cyber Security (FOCS / BACS) / National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) (ncsc.ch).
